BiblicalUsage: Chittah is terror, the dread that falls on whole cities, and it stands once in the story of Jacob. After the slaughter at Shechem, the terror of God falls on the cities round about, so that they do not pursue the sons of Jacob as they journey on.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the terror of God is His protection as well as His judgment, because it kept Jacob's family alive on the road, and the God who terrifies our enemies is the same God who keeps His promise to us.
